_doc: Items. size = [w,h] cells; stack = max per cell group; weight in kg each. Containers have grids [[w,h],...] and a slot (rig|backpack) or none (pouch). Medical items: med = bandage|hemostat|tourniquet|splint|medkit|surgical|painkiller, treats = effects removed, uses, use_time seconds. Blocks: block = material name. known=false items must be examined before their name shows.

items.name: Dirt
items.desc: Loose soil. Airtight when packed, not waterproof.

items.name: Cobblestone
items.desc: Broken stone. Heavy, airtight, waterproof, strong.

items.name: Planks
items.desc: Sawn wood. Light and floats, but leaks air and water and burns.

items.name: Clay Brick
items.desc: Fired clay. Airtight and waterproof.

items.name: Glass Pane
items.desc: Airtight and lets light through. Fragile.

items.name: Thatch
items.desc: Bundled grass. Blocks sight, not air. Burns instantly.

items.name: Clay
items.desc: Wet clay. Airtight and waterproof when packed.

items.name: Sand
items.desc: Loose sand. Neither airtight nor waterproof.

items.name: Gravel
items.desc: Loose stones. Porous.

items.name: Log
items.desc: A section of trunk. Airtight but burns.

items.name: Plant Fiber
items.desc: Leaves and grass. Crafting material.

items.name: Bandage
items.desc: Stops light bleeding. Three wraps.

items.name: Hemostat
items.desc: Clotting agent. Stops heavy bleeding anywhere.

items.name: Tourniquet
items.desc: Stops heavy bleeding on a limb. Hurts.

items.name: Splint
items.desc: Sets a fracture.

items.name: Painkillers
items.desc: Suppresses pain for three minutes. Does not heal.

items.name: Field Medkit
items.desc: Restores health from a limited pool. Also stops light bleeds.

items.name: Trauma Kit
items.desc: A big pool of healing. Stops any bleed.

items.name: Surgical Kit
items.desc: Restores a destroyed limb to 1 HP at the cost of 20% of its maximum.

items.name: Pouch
items.desc: A small bag. Fits inside a backpack.

items.name: Chest Rig
items.desc: Four pockets across the chest. Fast to reach.

items.name: Day Pack
items.desc: A 4x4 backpack.

items.name: Expedition Pack
items.desc: Big main compartment plus a lid pocket.

items.name: Breather Mask
items.desc: Scrubs most of the gas from each breath while its filter lasts. Heavy, and the filter is consumable.

items.name: Breather Filter
items.desc: A fresh filter for the breather mask.
